game_title: Divide Or Floor – Ore Smelter Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, cinder bats strike the fire shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from cinder bats in Ore Smelter: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while share > 0.
